steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly without recreating or searching for it.
Open the RFQ-to-Auction conversion flow from the published RFQ project page.
Confirm conversion landed on the auction create screen.

args.goal: On the RFQ-to-Auction conversion screen, inspect the reuse options, select reuse nothing so RFQ quotes, participants, and weights are not reused, click Continue, configure the auction and schedule, and attempt to publish; prove that the auction contains the RFQ products but no participants were reused and publishing is blocked until participants are added.

steps.note: Exercise and verify the conversion pop-up options and the resulting no-participant auction state, which have no dedicated catalog assertions.
